deadline_policy: Freeze absolute UTC deadline before first new hosted launch. Reserve every attempt before dispatch, including probes and failures; no reopening prior budgets.

base_assumptions.debit_basis: ACT/360 previous closing negative USD cash
base_assumptions.execution: Preserve funded staged MOO controller; causal selection and explicit history readiness

stress.comparison: Two separately labelled matched stress cases; do not attribute combined effect to cost or delay alone

acceptance.asset_momentum: Positive net CAGR difference versus same-five-ETF equal weight; report DD and temporal opportunity cost
acceptance.stock_momentum: Positive net CAGR difference versus same historical eligible universe equal weight; separately report matched stress difference
acceptance.lowvol: Smaller full-period closing DD than same historical eligible universe equal weight, with nonnegative full-period CAGR; report displaced growth and duration
acceptance.evidence_gate: Diagnosed missing-history events; causal/finite/ready inputs; matched controls/costs/calendars; complete summaries and reconciliation; failed gates mean inconclusive, not a financial win
acceptance.decision: Retain for independent validation only if evidence gate and declared mechanism test pass; stop this fixed variant if mechanism test fails; inconclusive for conflicting/insufficient evidence. No live promotion.

execution_gate: Order-free readiness diagnosis first, then freeze versioned executable sources, hashes and exact timing/eligibility rules before financial launch. This design itself cannot authorize arbitrary financial variants.
stops: No free data/access or unresolved causal/history integrity: stop dependent runs and preserve evidence
limits: Viewed development history, not independent OOS
Retain/stop decisions apply to these exact adaptations, not entire literature
